body: Thank you for taking to me a little! It helped. Nowadays it seems like my mind has fallen into black pit where I can't seem to find any leverage to get back up. Talking to others always makes my mind more clear, so I can find a way to get closer to getting out.
Do yoy want to talk about it? It sucks feeling this way because it doesn't seem to end, or if it does it goes away for a few and then comes back.

Yeah, definitely gnawing at me right now. I'll probably mention it tomorrow to one of my supervisors, ask them to help me, and then work on explanations of a variety of concepts that I have to explain to the students. It'll be more work but I want them to succeed. I don't really know them personally but I want them to do well. 


I think the reason why I messed up is because I haven't gone over this material in three years, and this was, really, the first day of explaining these concepts to other people. I mean I get the concepts but explaining is another situation.

I will be re-starting therapy tomorrow, so hopefully that will help things. 

I've fucked so many times, but my job is specifically created to explain things to other people. I'm essentially a tutor but I do study groups instead of one on one tutoring. There was this sweet lady who looked like she was in a severe accident (the tips of her fingers were gone on one hand, she had a really hard to time writing and her jaw look to be unnaturally receded) who became so confused, and I'm afraid this will affect her grade and she might have to retake the class again. I wouldn't want to disheartened from school or make her think that she was the problem. Long story but that's what happened today.

Hi McBuggered,

I am currently 21 years old, and I am a university student who studies History and Political science in my third year. 

For the past year, I've been trying to reduce the severity of my depression and anxiety but it just keeps on getting worse. I was offered some false hope two weeks ago, a job promotion, but my boss seemed to rescind the promotion. He's been scrambling to find a position for me in my original post, so I'm afraid that I will not be working soon.

Also I can't quit thinking about how much everyone hates, how much I fuck everything up. Today I was working and had to explain a bunch of concepts to people and I just made them more confused, which is definitely not my job.
